name: Create livestock National Vendor Declarations (NVDs) and movement records
summary: Keeps a livestock stock register from the farm's AgriWebb records and drafts each NVD's stock lines from it, flagging any tag it cannot match. Crons read and draft only; the vendor signs each NVD and records each NLIS movement.

covered_by.gather-animal-ids: draft (stock-register reads AgriWebb; nvd-draft matches the tags)
covered_by.draft-nvd: draft (nvd-draft lists the stock lines; the NVD itself is completed by the vendor)
covered_by.nlis-movement-record: not covered (no NLIS platform or operation is mapped)
covered_by.transport-booking: not covered (AgriWebb's docs do not describe it)
covered_by.hand-over-at-yards: not covered (AgriWebb's docs do not describe it)
covered_by.buyer-receipt: not covered (AgriWebb's docs do not describe it)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (stock register and NVD drafts kept in the workflow store)

crons.name: stock-register
crons.summary: Copy the farm's animals and management groups from AgriWebb into the local stock register.

crons.name: nvd-draft
crons.summary: Match each new NVD request's tags to the stock register and draft its stock lines; flag any tag it cannot match.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. Nothing here writes to AgriWebb on a cron. mutation.addRecords is a live operation: it is listed for a future movement-record step and is never run without an approval.

agriwebb.covers: stock register read (animals and management groups); no write adapter yet

gaps: Confirm the workflow steps and default settings with the business before use.
NLIS (nlis.com.au): no platform folder in core/sdk/platforms and no mapped operations. NLIS movement lodging is not automated.
eNVD (integritysystems.com.au): no platform folder and no mapped operations. All 10 captured pages held navigation text only, with no step text.
Agrinous (agrinous.com): no platform folder and no mapped operations.
AgriWebb has no NVD or NLIS lodging in its operations. Its movement record is an internal ManagementGroupChanged record, not an NLIS movement, so no write adapter is built.
AgriWebb tag match: the NLIS tag is assumed to be identity.eid. Confirm which identity field holds the NLIS number on a live account before relying on the match.
AgriWebb sign-in: bearer token from AGRIWEBB_ACCESS_TOKEN only; the token exchange is not built (platform.json). No live account has been tested.
mutation.addRecords is listed as a live op but no cron queues it. A movement-record adapter needs the AnimalIdentityInput shape confirmed first.
No CLI command yet adds an NVD request to the store. The agent writes each request to the nvd-requests namespace until one exists.
Transport booking, saleyard or buyer handover, and buyer receipt have no mapped source in AgriWebb, eNVD or NLIS.
